question: Which of the following ions is not isoelectronic with the others? O<sup>2-</sup>, F<sup>-</sup>, Na<sup>+</sup>, Mg<sup>+</sup>
explanation: O<sup>2-</sup> (10 e<sup>-</sup>), F<sup>-</sup> (10 e<sup>-</sup>), Na<sup>+</sup> (10 e<sup>-</sup>), whereas Mg<sup>+</sup> has 11 - 1 = 10? Wait: Mg atomic number is 12, so Mg<sup>+</sup> has 11 electrons. Therefore, Mg<sup>+</sup> is not isoelectronic.

question: The correct order of ionic radii for the species F<sup>-</sup>, Na<sup>+</sup>, and O<sup>2-</sup> is:
explanation: All have 10 electrons. As nuclear charge increases from O (8) to F (9) to Na (11), radius decreases: O<sup>2-</sup> (140 pm) > F<sup>-</sup> (133 pm) > Na<sup>+</sup> (102 pm).

question: Which of the following species is isoelectronic with Ne?
explanation: Neon has 10 electrons. Na<sup>+</sup>, Mg<sup>2+</sup>, and Al<sup>3+</sup> all have 10 electrons.

question: Among the following, the species with the largest radius is:
explanation: Cl<sup>-</sup>, Ar, K<sup>+</sup>, and Ca<sup>2+</sup> are isoelectronic (18 electrons). Cl<sup>-</sup> has the lowest nuclear charge (Z = 17), making it the largest.

question: Which pair of molecules is isoelectronic?
explanation: CO (6 + 8 = 14 e<sup>-</sup>) and N<sub>2</sub> (7 + 7 = 14 e<sup>-</sup>) are isoelectronic.
